source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 22 April 1939, p. 1 ("Nominations in Tyrone ... Castlederg Guardians and Council"); Ulster Herald, 22 April 1939, p. 5 ("Castlederg Guardians and Council")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 'For division of Clunahill no nomination was received, the retiring member for which was Mr. Michael M'Crea'; the same report says that where no nominations were received 'the returning members are deemed to have been re-elected' (Omagh Rural)

note: Triennial election of the Castlederg rural district councillors, 1939. Nominations closed on 18 April 1939. One candidate was nominated in each of fifteen divisions and returned unopposed; 'All retiring representatives were returned except Messrs. John James Young and John M'Askie, who replace Mr. James Leitch, J.P., and Capt. D. B. Williams, J.P.' For Clunahill no nomination was received and the retiring member, Mr. Michael M'Crea, was deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed. No poll was held; the folder date is the provisional Tyrone polling day. No nomination was received; the report names the retiring member, Mr. Michael M'Crea. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
